title: aster erigeroides var. trinervius
intro: Aster erigeroides var. trinervius, commonly known as Trinerve Aster, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Aster erigeroides var. trinervius include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help in reducing pain, promoting wound healing, and easing coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
